author: DonKent
quote: 0/10 – Disrespectful to the players. Rockstar had 13 years to develop this game, yet couldn't deliver a properly optimized experience on current consoles. They could have released it on PC as well, or waited for the next generation of consoles instead of selling players a compromised experience. 30 FPS, excessive blur and motion sickness make this game physically uncomfortable to play. Rockstar shouldn't expect blind loyalty from its customers. We deserve better.
